entries.hook: The night the backup drive clicked and everything almost disappeared
entries.body: Lin's external drive started clicking at 1 a.m., three days before the studio delivery. Every design file from the past two years lived on it. We spent four hours on recovery tools that kept freezing at 12%. Lin didn't cry until the files finally copied over to the new drive, all of them, intact. She said, "I thought I lost two years of myself." We wrote the three-location backup rule that same night, at 5 a.m., before either of us would let the other sleep.

entries.hook: The box of books the movers lost between Shanghai and Hangzhou
entries.body: Six boxes left the Shanghai apartment; five reached Hangzhou. The missing one held Lin's annotated design books, the ones with ten years of margin notes. The moving company offered five hundred yuan and an apology template. Lin said the money wasn't the point; the marginalia was the only proof of how her taste had changed. She keeps the claim email starred, not for the refund, but as she puts it, "a receipt for a version of myself."

entries.hook: Adopting Miso, the orange cat who chose the carrier by himself
entries.body: The shelter visit was supposed to be "just looking." An orange cat walked into the open carrier while Lin was still reading another cat's profile card, sat down, and stared at us. The volunteer said he'd been returned twice for "being too loud at night." Lin signed the papers within the hour. He yelled the entire ride home, and Lin yelled back conversationally. They have been in agreement ever since.

entries.hook: Miso's spay surgery at Dr. Song's clinic
entries.body: Scheduled, boring in the best way. Dr. Song called it "the most routine procedure we do," and it was. The only drama: Miso in the cone afterward, walking backward around the living room for an hour, personally offended by physics. Lin slept on the couch next to him the first night anyway. Follow-up in ten days, stitches out, done.

entries.hook: Emergency vet run, Miso swallowed a hair tie
entries.body: Not scheduled, not boring. Miso ate a hair tie at 11 p.m. and we were at the emergency clinic by 11:40. Dr. Song was off; the night vet induced vomiting and charged a number Lin refuses to say out loud. Miso was fine in an hour and demanded dinner. Lin threw away every hair tie in the apartment and now wears one on her wrist only, like a hostage negotiation.

entries.hook: First driving test attempt, failed on the reverse parking line
entries.body: First subject-two attempt. Everything clean until reverse parking, where the rear wheel kissed the line by what the examiner called "a visible margin." Lin's own review: "I was not nervous. I was pre-nervous, which is worse." She booked the retake before we left the parking lot, which I logged at the time as either resilience or spite. She has since confirmed: both.

entries.hook: 2026-06-25 Second attempt, stalled on the hill start
entries.body: Second attempt, different failure. Reverse parking was fine this time; the hill start stalled twice. Lin came home, ate an entire bag of shrimp chips methodically, and said only: "The car and I have a philosophical disagreement about clutches." Retake booked for July. No notes were requested, so none were given.

entries.hook: 2026-07-14 Third try, the wheels stayed inside
entries.body: Third attempt. She messaged me from the lot before the result was official: "wheels stayed inside. WHEELS STAYED INSIDE." We are not correcting the all-caps. The first two failures each had their own flavor, the line and then the clutch, which makes this pass a complete set. Next: highway practice, which she is "absolutely not nervous about," stated while rescheduling it twice.

entries.hook: The agency dropped us, the biggest client gone in one email
entries.body: Four lines, no call, effective end of month. The agency had been sixty percent of Lin's income since January. She read the email twice, put the phone face down, and vacuumed the entire apartment including the ceiling corners. Then she opened a spreadsheet titled "actual runway, no lying." The number said four months. That spreadsheet became the reference point for everything that happened in May.

entries.hook: Back to job boards, looking for full-time roles again
entries.body: Decision after the runway spreadsheet: rebuild the resume, target full-time product roles, treat freelancing as a bridge that didn't hold. Lin called it "the sensible thing." She updated the portfolio the same week and said the word "sensible" the way other people say "surrender."

entries.hook: Staying independent, the studio contract changed the math
entries.body: Supersedes the April decision to go back to job boards. The game studio contract is signed: three months, renewable, and a rate she named without lowering it mid-sentence this time. The runway spreadsheet got a new tab titled "actual runway, still no lying," and the number stopped being scary. She keeps the old entry on purpose. "I want to remember that I almost quit, and why I didn't."

entries.hook: The farewell bowl of scallion oil noodles at A-Kang's
entries.body: The Friday ritual's final Shanghai edition, at the lane-house noodle shop she'd been going to for fourteen months. A-Kang heard she was moving and slid a fried egg onto the noodles without being asked, then pretended he hadn't. Lin photographed the bowl from the same angle as always, fourteen months of nearly identical photos, and cried a little into the scallion oil, which she claims "improved the seasoning." The ritual was declared portable, pending a Hangzhou successor.

entries.hook: 面川第一次——杭州拉面仪式的候选一号
entries.body: 搬来一个多月后第一次认真执行周五仪式。面川的豚骨汤偏咸,老板娘看 Lin 拍照,主动把葱花摆匀了再端上来。Lin 给了 7.5 分,评语是"汤够狠,但蛋不如阿康家"。仪式认证暂缓,下周去试竹里馆。照片角度和上海那十四个月保持一致,她说这是"连续性的最低成本维护"。

entries.hook: 2026-07-10 竹里馆二访——仪式店定了
entries.body: 竹里馆第二次,鸡白汤,蛋是溏心的,8.5 分,超过面川。Lin 宣布周五仪式正式落户竹里馆,面川降级为"汤太狠的备胎"。老板记住了她的忌口(不要木耳),这件事在评分里占了 0.5 分。十四个月零三周的同角度照片序列继续。

entries.hook: 外婆住院的第一晚——走廊里的塑料椅
entries.body: 体检查出的问题要住院观察一周。第一晚 Lin 在走廊塑料椅上坐到凌晨两点,不是医院要求,是她自己走不开。外婆睡着以后她才跟我说话,声音压得很低,问的却全是很大的问题。我没有给答案,只是陪她把每一个问题说完。后来她说那晚的走廊灯"白得像没有时间"。

entries.hook: 外婆出院那天在医院楼下吃的葱包烩
entries.body: 出院手续办完已经中午,外婆不肯直接回家,要在医院对面的小摊吃葱包烩,"住院的饭没有锅气"。Lin 陪她站在路边吃完两个,外婆把竹签排整齐,宣布下周开始一周教一道菜,"趁脑子还记得配方"。那是菜谱计划的开始,也是 Lin 那一周第一次笑。

entries.hook: 外婆的菜谱计划——一周一道,已收八道
entries.body: 从糖醋排骨开始,每周日下午一道。外婆口述,Lin 执行,我记录。目前八道:糖醋排骨、油焖笋、酱鸭、腌笃鲜、葱烤鲫鱼、梅干菜扣肉、龙井虾仁、荷叶粉蒸肉。外婆的计量单位是"一点""差不多""看它自己",我们建立了换算表但外婆拒绝承认其权威性。计划持续中。

entries.hook: Letter, the day the first independent invoice was paid
entries.body: Lin, the studio's payment landed today. I watched you check the banking app four times before believing the number. You've been paid before, salaries, agency transfers, but this one you priced, negotiated, and invoiced with your own name at the top. You said it felt "like the money knew my name." I'm writing this down so that on some future bad day, you can reread the exact date the runway stopped being a countdown and started being a road.

entries.hook: 和丹丹闹翻——展位设计署名的误会
entries.body: 丹丹把合作的展位设计发到社交平台没带 Lin 的署名,Lin 在评论区看到第三个人夸"丹丹的构图"时炸了。两个人在语音里都说了重话,Lin 挂断后手还在抖。当时的结论是"这段友情到此为止"。(此结论后被 demo_020 修正,保留本条是为了记得当时真的这么想过。)

entries.hook: 和丹丹和解——西湖边走完一圈才说到正题
entries.body: 丹丹约的见面,两个人绕西湖走了大半圈都在说废话,快到断桥才说正题:署名不是她删的,是平台转发模板吞的,她发现后补了三条评论没人看。Lin 也承认自己当时没问就定罪。走完一圈,友情恢复,新规矩一条:任何联名作品发布前互相过目。不是丹丹的错,也不全是误会的错,是两个人都默认了对方会解释。

entries.hook: The night Miso got out through the window screen
entries.body: The screen had a gap we both knew about and kept meaning to fix. Miso found it around ten. Lin walked the block with a flashlight and a bag of treats until almost four, calling his name in a voice that got smaller every hour. I ran through shelter listings and neighborhood groups and said the survival statistics out loud exactly once, which was a mistake. A neighbor found him at 4:10, asleep on the warm hood of a parked car two buildings down. Lin fixed the screen at five in the morning with packing tape and did not speak until it was done.

entries.hook: The first apartment viewing, the one with the smell
entries.body: The listing photos were generous. The actual unit had a water stain shaped like Australia and a smell the agent described as "character." Lin opened every window during the tour out of politeness and breathed through her mouth. On the walk back she said the rent explained itself. We crossed it off before reaching the metro station.

entries.hook: The second viewing, the one with the persimmon tree
entries.body: Second viewing, different planet. Sixth floor, afternoon light, and a landlady who talked about the persimmon tree in the courtyard like a tenant with seniority. She knocked a hundred off the rent when she heard Lin worked from home, on the theory that someone should be around to appreciate the tree in October. Lin signed that week. The tree is due to deliver in October; the landlady has promised updates.

entries.hook: 2026-07-18 First highway practice, two missed exits
entries.body: First supervised highway run since passing. Merging went better than expected. Exits did not: she missed the same one twice from opposite directions, which the instructor called "geometrically impressive." Home safe, mildly furious, already booked for Saturday. She says the highway and she are "not fighting, just negotiating."

entries.hook: The call where she said the rate and then said nothing
entries.body: The studio pushed back on her quote, the way clients do, with a pause meant to be filled. Old Lin filled pauses at a discount. This time she said the number again, slower, and then let the silence sit there doing her negotiating for her. Eleven seconds. I counted. The producer said he'd "make it work." She hung up and yelled into a cushion, happy edition.

entries.hook: 2026-07-02 New monitor and a desk lamp, office corner done
entries.body: The studio contract paid for a proper monitor, 27 inches, and a lamp that doesn't flicker. Lin spent longer on cable management than on choosing the monitor. The office corner is now officially done, according to Lin, for the third time.

entries.hook: Letter, one month after the window screen
entries.body: Lin, it's been a month since the screen night, so I can say this now. You apologized to the cat for the gap in the screen, twice, formally. He forgot the whole thing by breakfast. You didn't, and I think that difference is most of what people mean by loving something small: he gets to forget, you keep the tape on the window. The hardware store sells proper screen mesh. We should still go.

entries.hook: Friday fallback: convenience store rice balls on the curb
entries.body: The noodle shop closed for a family thing, handwritten sign on the door. The ritual's backup clause activated for the first time: two convenience store rice balls and a canned coffee on the curb outside the shop, eaten facing the closed door out of principle. Lin rated the evening 6 out of 10, "would be stranded again."

entries.hook: Highway confidence plan, four Saturdays
entries.body: Standing project, four checkpoints: ring road with instructor, ring road solo, cross-river bridge, and the airport run as a graduation trip. Rule written by Lin herself: one checkpoint per Saturday, no skipping ahead on a good mood, no quitting on a bad one. Current status: checkpoint one scheduled, mood officially "negotiating."

entries.hook: Three drives and a fireproof box, the rule becomes hardware
entries.body: The three-location rule from the bad night turned into actual objects: one drive on the desk, one in a fireproof box in the wardrobe, one cloud sync that runs at 3 a.m. Lin labeled the box in marker: IN CASE OF EVERYTHING. The weekly check takes four minutes and she has skipped it zero times in nine weeks, a personal record across all habit categories.

entries.hook: 外婆教腌笃鲜
entries.body: 屏幕里外婆把手机靠在酱油瓶上,灶台上那锅汤咕嘟咕嘟响。她教Lin听声音,说气泡闷下去的时候要撇浮沫。Lin举着锅铲不敢眨眼,居然没烧糊也没放咸,头一回。外婆隔着屏幕闻了闻:"八十分,那二十分扣在我闻不到。"

entries.hook: 字体人情
entries.body: 周年折扣,两百个名额,往年三分钟抢光。Lin惦记那套字体授权惦记了一整月,一直没舍得。消息提示音响的时候,丹丹发来截图:付款回执,一张成本价的账单,末尾一句"你欠我一个将来的人情,随时来要,不打招呼"。和好之后她们的新规矩看起来是管用的:少猜,多留凭据。Lin盯着屏幕看了半天,回了一个字,行。

entries.hook: 蒸完的虾跟橡皮筋一样
entries.body: 第九道,龙井虾仁,菜谱计划头一次砸了。Lin多做了一倍的虾,火却只敢开到原来的大小,锅底一下凉了。外婆在电话那头笑,半天才停:东西多了,胆子没多。明天重来,这个礼拜不能翻篇。我以为她才是定规矩的人。

entries.hook: Half a day at the moving company's office for one damaged box
entries.body: The seventh box arrived crushed on one corner, kitchenware rattling in a way kitchenware shouldn't. Filing the claim took a whole morning at the movers' storefront office: three counters, one form filled out twice for reasons nobody defended, and a compensation number computed on the declared value of used pots. Lin took the money, carried the box to the bus stop, and ate a celebration egg tart on top of it while waiting. The pots were mostly fine. The paperwork went into the folder labeled "evidence."

entries.hook: Letter, the night the Shanghai offer called twice
entries.body: Lin, the recruiter called twice tonight and you let it ring the second time. The package was real: salary you could say out loud at family dinner, a title, an office with a river view. You wrote the pros in one column and then, instead of cons, you wrote what the runway spreadsheet is actually for. You said the freelance thing isn't a bridge you got stuck on, it's the road you picked. I'm recording the date because on some future invoice-chasing Tuesday you will want proof that you chose this on purpose, at night, with the phone ringing.
